versions.changelog: Added: 新浪财经7x24小时实时快讯 + 新浪财经点击量排行 + 美股TOP100. Enhanced: platform coverage expanded from 4 to 9 sources. Expanded: screening criteria refined for real-time news value.

- Initial release with daily finance news aggregation.
- Pulls top trending investment news from Wallstreetcn, Xueqiu, Yicai, and Baidu Finance.
- Filters and selects up to 5 valuable headlines relevant to investors.
- Does not provide real-time market data; refers users to akshare-stock for those needs.
- Simple, fact-focused output with clearly separated news listings from each platform.
